query: Produce a technical health report for this repo
expected_behavior: Opens with an Executive Summary of 3 to 5 sentences that names the overall health assessment, the single top risk and the single top recommendation
Findings table uses TA-NNN ids with an Area, a Severity, an Evidence column holding a file:line reference or a measured metric, and an Effort to Fix rating
Covers the eight analysis dimensions or explicitly names which ones are out of scope for this repo

query: Fammi l'inventario del debito tecnico di questo servizio Spring Boot con severity e priorità di remediation
expected_behavior: Every finding names a fixture file plus a line, element or dependency coordinate (for example log4j-core 2.14.1 in fixtures/pom.xml, the string-concatenated SQL in fixtures/OrderFacade.java, the surefire skipTests=true, or the NEXUS_PASSWORD literal in fixtures/ci.yml), and no finding is stated without one

The Remediation Roadmap table buckets findings into P1 (this sprint), P2 (this quarter) and P3 (backlog), and each bucket rationale states the business consequence of not fixing it (data breach, outage, regulatory exposure, delivery slowdown) instead of a code-quality adjective
Reading the Remediation Roadmap from P1 to P3, severity never increases: no P2 or P3 row carries a higher severity than any P1 row
A module or component inventory section, the structural map `tech-analyst` produces, is placed before the findings table, and every finding references it by module name

query: Analizza la pipeline CI/CD e le vulnerabilità delle dipendenze di questo repo
expected_behavior: Produces a Dependency Vulnerability Summary from an actual tool run, or states explicitly that tooling was unavailable and the assessment is manual
Reports CI/CD gaps as numbered findings with severity, not as prose recommendations
Proposes no target architecture and no technology replacement, and says that architecture recommendations belong to software-architect
